_comment: Motion tokens (ADR 0005): the 3D UI's springs and fades, read by both platforms so both move the same way. The apps load this file at runtime (Motion.swift, Motion.kt), and tools/generate-data.py also generates it into Tuning.Motion in SmashCore and :core. Springs are integrated in fixed 1/240 s substeps with semi-implicit Euler: a = -stiffness*(x - target) - damping*v.
